content:
Ultraman R/B is a Japanese tokusatsu television series produced by Tsuburaya Productions as part of the Ultra Series. It premiered on July 7, 2018, and aired until December 22, 2018, with a total of 25 episodes.

The series follows the Minato siblings, Katsumi and Isami, who encounter an alien named Makoto Aizen and receive the power to transform into Ultramen. Katsumi transforms into Ultraman Rosso, who is red in color and represents Fire, while Isami transforms into Ultraman Blu, who is blue in color and represents Water. Together, they protect the city of Ayaka from various monsters and threats.

Ultraman R/B features a unique transformation device called the Rube Gyro, which allows the Minato siblings to switch forms between Rosso and Blu during battle. The series also introduces various new forms and power-ups for the Ultramen, as well as a supporting cast of characters who assist the siblings in their fight against evil.

Overall, Ultraman R/B received positive reviews for its fresh take on the Ultraman franchise, dynamic action scenes, and engaging storyline. It has also spawned a variety of merchandise, including toys, video games, and spin-off media.
